module "ShaderFunctionResult.dsf"

product 0 MaterialFunction "Functions/MF_LiResult" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="InColor", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float3 @L2:C1 "InColor"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L15:C28 "Result"
  %2 = Multiply(%0, %1) : float3 @L15:C18 "Result"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0.25)) : float @L16:C18 "Weight"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0.75)) : float @L17:C17 "Extra"
  %5 = FunctionOutput(%2, OutputName="Result", SortPriority=0) @L2:C1 "Result"
  %6 = FunctionOutput(%3, OutputName="Weight", SortPriority=1) @L2:C1 "Weight"
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%4, OutputName="Extra", SortPriority=2) @L2:C1 "Extra"
  inputs %0
  outputs %5, %6, %7
